input: one retained sonar-inspection-scene-20261031 record; no duplicate acquisition
poses: causal emitted IMU/DVL/pressure default-navigation means; no acoustic or RGB input
opencv: existing research Python 4.10.0; native SDK and ABI unchanged
detector: AKAZE defaults, existing raw 20-90 dB / 5x5 image transform, finite support, range >0.4 m; at most 300 features sorted by response
controls: mutual descriptor match with existing 0.8 nearest-neighbour ratio
mutual unique nominal projective match using full elevation arc

projective.sampling_control: compare decision distances to 65 samples without retuning thresholds

validation: all tracked observations at least 2 seconds after the last construction observation; retain all missing and out-of-fan counts; scene/truth enter separate assessment only
primary_method: Westman et al. ICRA 2018 section IV / Algorithm 1; projective geometry ingredient only, not a reproduction of the complete ASFM backend
